claim: grammar_valid: forall name, is_capability_name_grammar_valid name = true iff all grammar preconditions hold (ASCII, segments, dots)

claim: length_bound: forall name with len > 128, result is CapabilityNameTooLong before grammar classification
first_error: empty -> CapabilityNameEmpty; len > 128 -> CapabilityNameTooLong; invalid_grammar -> CapabilityNameInvalid; valid -> Ok
model: Error ordering: empty before too_long before grammar before valid
refinement: Precedence is deterministic and matches contract

claim: duplicate_detection: forall caps i j with i < j and caps[i] == caps[j], result is CapabilityDuplicate with first_index=i and duplicate_index=j
model: O(n^2) search returning earliest duplicate pair by index
refinement: Earliest duplicate by index ordering is reported

claim: duplicate_scope: same name with different action in same contract is not a duplicate
model: Scope is exactly one ActionContract.required_capabilities list
refinement: Same name different action is not duplicate
shell_exclusions: only called within one contract's capability list

claim: action_relation: forall contract_action cap where cap.action != contract_action, result is CapabilityActionMismatch
refinement: Capability action must match enclosing contract id
